messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"book_code":"2ES","chapter":12,"verses":[{"verse":21,"chapter":12,"text":"Two of them will perish when the middle time approaches. Four will be kept for a while until the time of the ending of it will approach; but two will be kept to the end."},{"verse":22,"chapter":12,"text":"You saw three heads resting. This is the interpretation:"},{"verse":23,"chapter":12,"text":"In its last days, the Most High will raise up three kingdoms and renew many things in them. They will rule over the earth,"},{"verse":24,"chapter":12,"text":"and over those who dwell in it, with much oppression, more than all those who were before them. Therefore they are called the heads of the eagle."},{"verse":25,"chapter":12,"text":"For these are those who will accomplish her wickedness, and who will finish her last actions."},{"verse":26,"chapter":12,"text":"You saw that the great head disappeared. It signifies that one of them will die on his bed, and yet with pain."},{"verse":27,"chapter":12,"text":"But for the two that remained, the sword will devour them."},{"verse":28,"chapter":12,"text":"For the sword of the one will devour him that was with him, but he will also fall by the sword in the last days."},{"verse":29,"chapter":12,"text":"You saw two under wings passing over to the head that is on the right side."},{"verse":30,"chapter":12,"text":"This is the interpretation: These are they whom the Most High has kept to his end. This is the brief reign that was full of trouble, as you saw."},{"verse":31,"chapter":12,"text":"“The lion, whom you saw rising up out of the forest, roaring, speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness, and all her words which you have heard,"},{"verse":32,"chapter":12,"text":"this is the anointed one, whom the Most High has kept to the end [of days, who will spring up out of the seed of David, and he will come and speak] to them and reprove them for their wickedness and unrighteousness, and willheap up before them their contemptuous dealings."},{"verse":33,"chapter":12,"text":"For at first he will set them alive in his judgment, and when he has reproved them, he will destroy them."},{"verse":34,"chapter":12,"text":"For he will deliver the rest of my people with mercy, those who have been preserved throughout my borders, and he will make them joyful until the coming of the end, even the day of judgment, about which I have spoken to you from the beginning."},{"verse":35,"chapter":12,"text":"This is the dream that you saw, and this is its interpretation."},{"verse":36,"chapter":12,"text":"Only you have been worthy to know the secret of the Most High."},{"verse":37,"chapter":12,"text":"Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and put it in a secret place."},{"verse":38,"chapter":12,"text":"You shall teach them to the wise of your people, whose hearts you know are able to comprehend and keep these secrets."},{"verse":39,"chapter":12,"text":"But wait here yourself seven more days, that you may be shown whatever it pleases the Most High to show you.” Then he departed from me."},{"verse":40,"chapter":12,"text":"It came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I had not come again into the city, they all gathered together, from the least to the greatest, and came to me, and spoke to me, saying,"}]}
